import tempfile, os
from django.conf import settings
tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
src = os.path.join(tmp, 'src'); os.makedirs(src)
dst = os.path.join(tmp, 'dst')
# nested refs: a.css -> b.css -> c.png, forcing multiple passes
open(os.path.join(src, 'a.css'), 'w').write('body { background: url("b.css"); }')
open(os.path.join(src, 'b.css'), 'w').write('p { background: url("c.png"); }')
open(os.path.join(src, 'c.png'), 'wb').write(b'PNG')
settings.configure(
    DEBUG=False, STATIC_ROOT=dst, STATIC_URL='/static/',
    STATICFILES_STORAGE='django.contrib.staticfiles.storage.ManifestStaticFilesStorage',
    INSTALLED_APPS=['django.contrib.staticfiles'],
)
import django; django.setup()
from django.contrib.staticfiles.storage import staticfiles_storage
paths = {'a.css': (None, os.path.join(src, 'a.css')),
         'b.css': (None, os.path.join(src, 'b.css')),
         'c.png': (None, os.path.join(src, 'c.png'))}
from collections import Counter
c = Counter()
for name, hashed, processed in staticfiles_storage.post_process(paths):
    c[name] += 1
    print('yield:', name, '->', hashed)
print('yield counts:', dict(c))
assert all(v == 1 for v in c.values()), 'DUPLICATE YIELDS!'
print('OK: each file yielded exactly once')
EOF
